description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wattala, Wattala D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 512000
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring the determination of title for specific land parcels (Nos. 6 and 7) in Waththala village. It contains detailed land particulars including parcel numbers, extent, ownership details, and encumbrances, making it clearly a land-related matter that falls under Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
